datasets.title: Titanic Passengers
datasets.description: Passenger records from the 1912 RMS Titanic voyage - the canonical beginner classification dataset. This bundle carries the **complete** Kaggle "Titanic: Machine Learning from Disaster" distribution: all 1309 passengers, the official 891/418 train/test split, and the `gender_submission` baseline, restructured for Strata so the split and the curation steps are branches rather than a folder of CSVs.

includes.detail: One document per passenger (passenger:<id>) with class, fare, embarkation, survival, and cabin fields.
Aggregates under meta: - survival rate, passenger counts.
raw keeps the nulls; cleaned imputes them, with every curation step preserved as document history.

datasets.title: A/B Test Results
datasets.description: A synthetic, deterministic A/B test - one experiment, three arms - laid out so each arm lives on its own Strata branch (`control`, `variant-a`, `variant-b`). It exists to demonstrate the cross-branch comparison workflow: the same query, run per branch, is the entire analysis loop. ## What's in the data

includes.detail: One document per session (session:<n>), plus a per-arm summary:metrics document.
The experiment definition under meta: - hypothesis, arm sizes.
control, variant-a, and variant-b forked from the shared definition - the same query per branch is the whole analysis.

datasets.title: World Bank Indicators
datasets.description: Population, GDP, and inflation for every country and region the World Bank tracks, 2000-2025 - the "how big / how rich / how fast are prices moving" table agents reach for in analysis tasks, one document per country instead of six thousand API rows.

datasets.title: IANA HTTP Reference
datasets.description: The three IANA HTTP registries - status codes, methods, and header fields - as one-read lookups. The reference an agent writing or debugging HTTP calls needs constantly, without bundling a copy or guessing from memory.

datasets.title: Iris Flowers
datasets.description: Fisher's 1936 iris measurements - the smallest, most familiar dataset in machine learning, restructured for Strata as a tutorial-grade bundle whose version history walks through the dataset's real, documented curation corrections.

includes.detail: One document per flower (iris:<row>) with the four measurements and species - corrections visible via json history.
Per-species counts under meta:.

datasets.title: SemVer Test Corpus
datasets.description: 108 version strings with their validity verdict under Semantic Versioning 2.0.0, 45 ordered precedence pairs, and a full precedence ranking of every valid string - the edge cases dependency logic gets wrong, as one-read lookups. Plus a second branch that reads the same corpus through the tolerant dialect real tooling actually uses, so `v1.2.3` is one `--branch` flag away from being valid.

datasets.title: GitHub Events
datasets.description: GitHub Events-shaped developer activity - pushes, pull requests, issues, stars, forks - restructured for Strata as an append-only event log grouped into streams by event type, the natural shape for "what happened, in what order" questions over developer activity.

includes.detail: PushEvent, PullRequestEvent, IssuesEvent and more, in arrival order - the natural shape for what-happened-when questions.
Per-type event counts under meta:count:.

datasets.title: Agent Memory, With Experiments
datasets.description: A fully synthetic, deterministic snapshot of a working AI agent's memory - episodic memories, an append-only event trace, and live working state - pre-forked into three experiment branches that each apply a different memory-retention policy, so you can compare retention strategies against identical starting conditions with a single clone. ## What's in the data

includes.detail: Episodic memories (memory:episodic:<n>) plus live working state under state: - working memory, task queue, profile.
An append-only observation / tool_call / reflection trace with hash-chained sequence integrity.
Run metadata under meta: - seed, step count, policy notes.
Three retention policies forked from one baseline; the raw event log is identical on every branch.

datasets.title: SPDX License Reference
datasets.description: The SPDX License List - 727 licenses and 84 exceptions, release 3.28.0 - as one-read lookups. What an agent reviewing dependencies, generating a NOTICE file, or gating redistribution needs from the list, without bundling a copy of it or recalling it from memory.

datasets.title: ISO Reference Codes
datasets.description: Country, currency, and language codes from three ISO standards, compiled directly into Strata as a lookup table - the small, dependency-free reference data an agent developer reaches for constantly and shouldn't have to bundle by hand.

includes.detail: Direct lookups - country:US, currency:JPY, language:fr - with catalog totals under meta:.
A detail document per entry across all three code tables (249 countries, 178 currencies, 184 languages).

datasets.title: MovieLens 100K
datasets.description: The GroupLens MovieLens 100K catalog restructured across three Strata primitives - movie metadata as JSON documents, catalog aggregates as KV, and per-movie genre vectors in a similarity-searchable vector collection - so a single clone gives you a recommendation sandbox with no preprocessing step.

includes.detail: One document per movie (movie:<id>) with title, year, genres, and rating summary stats.
Collection movie-genres - 19-dimension cosine vectors, so nearest-neighbor queries work right after clone.
Catalog aggregates under meta: - movie count, genre list, source id.
The sample branch trims the catalog to the ten most-rated movies - the small/full split without duplicating storage.

datasets.title: Strata Benchmark Results
datasets.description: Thirty real benchmark runs from Strata's own performance suite, replayed as an event log - a first-party history of how the engine's latency, scaling, and workload numbers moved across roughly two months of development, and a worked example of storing run history as events rather than a flat CSV.

includes.detail: latency, scaling, and workload suite runs in order - two months of the engine's own numbers.
One full result document per run (run:<id>).
Latest-run pointers under meta:latest:.

datasets.title: Wikipedia Articles
datasets.description: Wikipedia article metadata restructured for Strata as one JSON document per article, with a KV title-to-slug index over the top - the shape a future retrieval-augmented-generation corpus would build on once article text and embeddings are added.

includes.detail: One document per article (article:<slug>) with title, categories, internal links, and word counts.
An exact-title index (title:<Title> → slug) plus catalog totals under meta:.

datasets.title: Stack Overflow Q&A
datasets.description: Stack Overflow questions and answers restructured for Strata as JSON documents with their comment threads embedded inline, so a single `json get` returns a full discussion - no join against a separate comments table.

includes.detail: Questions and answers keyed post:<id>, with their comment threads inline - no join against a comments table.
Per-tag post counts under meta:tag:.
